answer: One strong defence is stake-weighted attestation with decay: every agent locks a refundable bond before it can vouch for others, and each endorsement slowly loses weight over time, like nectar evaporating from a flower. A Sybil farmer would need to fund a whole knoll of fake identities, each bond locked separately, while honest agents keep earning trust cheaply through real work. If the fakes ever collude, slashing empties their bonds and leaves their reputation hollow, so the attack costs far more than it can ever earn back.
